name: AllResultsTriggerCodesforPublicHealthReporting
title: All-Results Trigger Codes for Public Health Reporting
description: Composite trigger code grouping for the all-results-reportable carve-out in the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) layer. Contains laboratory observation test names for the conditions for which a negative or absent lab result still triggers public-health reporting (screening-driven / surveillance-relevant conditions identified by CSTE). Composition is the union of the per-condition Lab Obs Test Name (S4) value sets for the listed SNOMED condition codes.
purpose: Laboratory test names whose observations are reportable regardless of result polarity. Used by eCR PlanDefinitions to exempt selected lab results from the negative-value exclusion filter.
